responsibility: Implements the `rustc_peek`-based sanity-checking harness for MIR dataflow analyses. It detects testing attributes on a body, runs the selected built-in analyses to a fixpoint, finds calls to the `rustc_peek` intrinsic in MIR, inspects the analysis state at those call sites, and emits diagnostics when the requested bit is not set or the intrinsic is used in an unsupported way.
